#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
vector<int> use(17);
int dfs(int n, int di)
{
    int res = (n / use[di]) * di;
    n = n % use[di];
    if (!n) return res;
    return res + min(dfs(use[di] - n, di - 1) + di, dfs(n, di - 1));
}

{
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; i++) use[i] = use[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    return 0;
}
